content.overview: Section 245 allows a class of members or depositors to seek Tribunal orders restraining ultra vires or fraudulent conduct and claiming damages.
content.glance: Section 245 allows a class of members or depositors to seek Tribunal orders restraining ultra vires or fraudulent conduct and claiming damages.
content.study: Class action. Section 245 allows a class of members or depositors to seek Tribunal orders restraining ultra vires or fraudulent conduct and claiming damages. The section applies only to the persons, companies, and transactions it names. A filing, approval, or penalty arises only where the section or a rule under it says so. It does not create a power that is reserved to another section or to the Tribunal. Not a verified closure.

sections.heading: Principle
sections.body: Section 245 allows a class of members or depositors to seek Tribunal orders restraining ultra vires or fraudulent conduct and claiming damages.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: The action can target the company, directors, auditors and experts. Thresholds are prescribed. The Tribunal considers good faith, alternative remedy, and evidence. Findings bind the class. This is distinct from a derivative action and from s. 241.

sections.heading: Ingredients
sections.body: Class of members or depositors; Ground in s. 245; Threshold; Binding order
